books.title: Practicing Mindfulness: 75 Essential Meditations to Reduce Stress, Improve Mental Health, and Find Peace in the Everyday
books.author: Matthew Sockolov
books.description: A guidebook of 75 mindfulness and loving-kindness practices, starting with five-minute meditations and building step by step towards a steadier daily practice. It also has practices for particular situations and emotions, with advice on wandering thoughts and common obstacles; no meditation experience is assumed.

flags: ISBN from https://www.penguin.com.au/books/practicing-mindfulness-9781641521710 (Callisto imprint, paperback, 11 September 2018: ISBN-13 9781641521710, converted to ISBN-10 1641521716), not confirmed elsewhere. Author and title confirmed on his own page https://oneminddharma.com/book/.
